e4be3ba5c3c7bf45.column_purpose: ID of one high schooler in the friendship pair; references Highschooler.col_001 (student ID).

412b05d7cbb7e028.column_purpose: ID of the other high schooler in the friendship pair; references Highschooler.col_001 (student ID). Which of the two columns is 'student' vs 'friend' is arbitrary since friendship is symmetric.

abf048b03ef2698d.column_purpose: Primary key: unique numeric identifier for each high school student. Referenced by Friend and Likes tables to identify the student in a friendship or like relationship.

8810f61899637fde.column_purpose: The student's first name. Not unique (e.g., Gabriel and Jordan appear twice).

273ed286322a0850.column_purpose: The student's grade level (year in school), values 9-12 (freshman through senior), evenly distributed with 4 students per grade.

15f0b089b6a38783.column_purpose: ID of the high schooler who likes someone (the source of the like). References Highschooler.col_001 (student ID). Declared primary key here, so each student appears as a liker at most once.

357415e6e9132803.column_purpose: ID of the high schooler who is liked (the target of the like). References Highschooler.col_001. Many-to-one: several students can like the same person (e.g. 1468 and 1709 are each liked twice).
